targeted_findings.r4_summary: The exact package does not contain every profile required by the run contracts, and several active arm-profile references are not version pinned.
targeted_findings.structural_change: R5 package adds EXPERIMENT_PROFILE, VERIFIER_PROFILE, and TRUST_ROOT_PROFILE contracts; arm profileReference requires profile_version; current package references are R5 exact-version pinned.
targeted_findings.residual_limitation: No executable package resolver was built; the contract is statically inspectable and exact-versioned.

targeted_findings.r4_summary: The source-schema membership registry names ten source schema ID/version pairs that are not members of the closed R4 schema-contract inventory.
targeted_findings.structural_change: All 13 active source-schema ID/version pairs resolve through the R5 package; ten formerly absent pairs use the closed typed source-record contract.
targeted_findings.residual_limitation: The shared source-record envelope intentionally does not define scenario-specific evidence semantics; source registry and existing profiles remain authoritative.

targeted_findings.r4_summary: The declared canonicalization profile does not identify the concrete schema/type form carried by generic bundle entries.
targeted_findings.structural_change: Concrete verifier, experiment, and scorer mappings bind container type, schema ID/version, record type, and content target; scorer entries carry R5 schema identity.
targeted_findings.residual_limitation: Digest verification remains a future implementation/conformance operation; the canonicalization contract is explicit for supplied digests.

targeted_findings.r4_summary: The R4 closed role vocabulary is enforced for role-visibility field rules but not for the roles arrays that govern source-schema membership.
targeted_findings.structural_change: Source-registry roles use the same nine-value enum as the package role vocabulary and role-visibility profile.
targeted_findings.residual_limitation: Future role additions require a new package/profile version; current package does not default unknown roles to visible or private.
